item.title: Sephora Canada : Wishlist
item.description: In partnership with Courage, Sephora Canada has launched a new holiday campaign that blends social listening with real-world media. The initiative leverages a simple but universal consumer insight: during the holidays, people routinely drop hints - subtle or otherwise - to get the gifts they actually want. Sephora’s approach amplified this behaviour by turning individual consumer submissions into creative assets, driving both engagement and real-world visibility. VIEW 3 OUTDOORS

item.description: BackgroundWhen Comfort Thailand introduced its new scent Cherry Vanilla inspired by Korean desserts.It wasn’t just about fragrance It was about emotion.Scent is the fastest trigger of memory and mood. It connects people to moments long before words can. VIEW OUTDOOR

item.title: Columbia Sportswear: Expedition Impossible
item.description: ​Columbia Sportswear has launched 'Expedition Impossible', a tongue-in-cheek challenge inviting outdoor adventurers to go find the edge of the Earth. And anyone who can prove the planet is flat will get everything owned by the company. The 'Expedition Impossible' challenge launches with an open letter by Columbia Sportswear Company CEO Tim Boyle in The New York Times and across its social channels, throwing down the gauntlet to tinfoil-hatted Flat Earther conspiracy theorists everywhere. item.title: Zalando: Family Photo
item.description: Just in time for the holiday season, Zalando, one of Europe’s leading online destinations for fashion and lifestyle, has launched its 2025 holiday campaign. As the festive season approaches, bringing with it a calendar full of reunions, parties, and unexpected moments, Zalando returns to answer the universal question: 'What Do I Wear?' VIEW THE 2 SPOTS

item.title: Glad: Don't Get Mad Glad
item.description: Trash bag and food wrap brand, Glad has revived its most popular, decades-long, star-studded ad campaign, 'Don't Get Mad. Get Glad.' item.title: Chupps Footwear: Earth
item.description: INTO Creative India’s latest film campaign created for Chupps footwear for their biodegradable footwear series. INTO Creative’s Founder & Chief Creative Officer Santosh Padhi, (Paddy) makes his debut as Director on the campaign. What if endings weren’t about loss, but about returning to where it all began? That idea sits at the heart of Chupps’ latest multimedia campaign for its 100% biodegradable Chupster range, a bold narrative that links human life to product truth. VIEW THE SPOTS
